description:
Descript is a video editor you can direct through conversation. 

Describe what you want — clean up a podcast episode, pull highlight clips from a webinar, translate a video into Spanish, or create one from scratch with a prompt. Descript handles the production: transcription, filler word removal, Studio Sound, captions, B-roll, clips, and more.

defaultPrompt: edit this recording for clarity, and clean up my audio
pull the 5 best clips from this week's episode
translate and dub this video into Spanish, French, and Japanese
